test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements :**

I. Some toys are small.

II. Some tall are toys.

**Conclusion :**

I. Some small are toys.

II. All small are tall.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
Statements :

I. Some toys are small.

II. Some tall are toys.

As per the given statements, the Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be8dc9e2f5a7f7ec8f956815879f04ad648d8889ac1fbd9935266c3cb38a73e1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e1e70aafde751c9c9781f2df8edf5c32b9e058a38724faf36f5978ebda5103d.png] 

Conclusion :

I. Some small are toys. →** Follow** (Some toys are small, which means some small are also toys)

II. All small are tall. →** not follow **(Because there is no definite relation between small and tall, so it can be possible only)

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusion I follow".**
